messages:
maya (cs): Quick flag  we have multiple onboarding customers who hit failures during the 21:15 UTC inference throttling window. Need an outbound template and list of accounts we should escalate commercially.

julian (acct-mgr): Affected accounts I can see: LumenEdge (trial), Greenline Labs (onboarding), OrchidAI (paid), TerraQuant (sandbox). Sending CSV DM in a few.

saira (cs): LumenEdge reported validation jobs timed out repeatedly. They're still in trial and we risk churn if they can't complete tests.

kevin (acct-owner): Mark LumenEdge as high priority. Recommend elevated remediation (12% credit + 72h warm pool). Also consider a one-month discount if they convert within 30 days.

harpreet (cs-dir): Default remediation approved: 8% credit + 48h warm pool. Exceptions up to 12% with owner sign-off. Legal review only if >12%.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-06-11 created -- affected window 2026-06-11T21:15:00Z to 2026-06-11T21:43:00Z. Root cause: control-plane autoscaler throttle leading to retry cascade.

security-bot: No evidence of data exposure. Network traces show backpressure and retries only.

maya (cs): Draft outbound below. Keep it concise and we'll personalize per account. Edits welcome.

maya (cs): ```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We experienced a temporary service disruption that affected inference throughput between ~21:15 and ~21:43 UTC on 2026-06-11. During this window some requests saw elevated latency and transient errors.

What we know:
- Root cause: an autoscaler throttling event that caused retries and backpressure in the control plane.
- No customer data exposure is suspected.

What were doing for you:
- Applying an 8% service credit for impacted usage by default; your account team will confirm the exact amount.
- Offering a complimentary 48-hour warm pool to reduce cold-start impact.
- For customers in onboarding or renewal review, we can offer an elevated package (12% credit + 72-hour warm pool) upon request.

Next steps: reply here or open ticket T-76214 if you saw greater impact and we will prioritize. An RCA will be shared within 72 hours with mitigation steps.

Thanks and sorry for the disruption,
Maya, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```

julian (acct-mgr): Suggest adding a short sentence for onboarding customers offering a 1:1 session to re-run validations. Also a direct contact line for urgent escalations.

maya (cs): Added 1:1 session line and urgent contact. Preparing personalized note for LumenEdge below.

maya (cs): ```
Hi LumenEdge team,

During your onboarding we observed a disruption affecting inference between 21:15 and 21:43 UTC on 2026-06-11 which prevented some validation runs from completing. There is no evidence of data exposure.

To make this right we will:
- Apply a 12% service credit for usage during the impacted window.
- Provision a complimentary 72-hour warm pool to stabilize validation runs.
- Schedule a 60-minute onboarding support session to re-run validations with our engineer and review retry/backoff settings.
- Pending your verbal OK, offer a one-month conversion discount if you sign within 30 days (CS to confirm).

Next steps: reply with preferred times for the session or ping your account team.

Thanks,
Maya, Customer Success
```

saira (cs): LumenEdge replied: "We'll take the 72h pool and need the session tomorrow morning PDT."

laura (solutions): I can run the session tomorrow 09:00 PDT. I'll prepare a short checklist and runbook for retries and validation.

kevin (acct-owner): Confirm we want the conversion discount option included for LumenEdge but only after CS gets verbal agreement. I'll standby.

harpreet (cs-dir): Elevated remediation approved for LumenEdge. Billing, please flag manual adjustment and apply 12% credit.

billing-bot: Billing ticket BLG-9981 created. Applying 12% credit to LumenEdge pending final CS confirmation.

maya (cs): Tasks: julian finalize CSV and send default outbound to remaining impacted customers (8%), laura run the LumenEdge session, billing apply credits, ops/incident attach RCA link to each outbound when available.

incident-bot: RCA draft expected by 2026-06-14T10:00:00Z.

maya (cs): I'll paste sent messages into this thread and track replies. If any renewal-risk accounts escalate, please tag #exec-ops immediately.
